total_supply_after_constructor.meaning: totalSupply value set by the HypoVault constructor

underlying_assets_after_constructor.meaning: underlying assets owned by the vault after the constructor

total_assets_before_first_fulfillment.meaning: totalAssets (computeNAV() == assetsDeposited) observed before the first fulfilment

share_price_integrations_wrong.meaning: performance-fee logic, NAV reporting and integrations relying on share price are wrong

assumptions: totalSupply and underlying-asset balances are observable integer quantities at the stated checkpoints.
The constructor checkpoint precedes the first fulfilment checkpoint.

unresolved.description: The intent states the vault should start with zero supply and mint shares only when assets exist, but the impact only asserts that fee/NAV/integration share-price logic is wrong; the report gives no observable share-price or NAV value to bind as the correspondence expected quantity, so the intent-to-impact relation cannot be expressed as a numeric correspondence without inventing a reference value.

limitations: The correspondence pattern compares constructor totalSupply against constructor underlying assets as the closest report-grounded restatement; the impact's share-price/NAV wrongness is only represented by a grounded Boolean outcome symbol.
No share-mint formula operands beyond the 1-wei denominator and the 1 000-asset / 1 000 000 000-share example are given, so no derived share quantity is defined.
